Short title extent and commencement

THE PAKISTAN MUJAHID FORCE ORDINANCE, 1965
THE PAKISTAN
MUJAHID FORCE ORDINANCE, 1965
ORDINANCE No. XXII
of 1965
[Approved by the National Assembly on 21st July, 1965, see
Gaz. of P. 1965. Ext. on. 588-592.]
[8th June, 1965]
An Ordinance to provide for the constitution and
discipline of the Pakistan Mujahid Force
CHAPTER I
PRELIMINARY
1. Short title extent and
commencement.----(1) This Ordinance may be called the Pakistan Mujahid
Force Ordinance, 1965.
(2) It extends to the whole of
Pakistan.
(3) It shall come into force on
such date[i.e. the 31st day of August, 1965,
see Gaz., of P., 1965, Ext., p. 771.] as the Central Government may, by
notification in the official Gazette, appoint in this behalf.

Persons subject to the Ordinance

THE PAKISTAN MUJAHID FORCE ORDINANCE, 1965
THE PAKISTAN
MUJAHID FORCE ORDINANCE, 1965
ORDINANCE No. XXII
of 1965
[Approved by the National Assembly on 21st July, 1965, see
Gaz. of P. 1965. Ext. on. 588-592.]
[8th June, 1965]
An Ordinance to provide for the constitution and
discipline of the Pakistan Mujahid Force
CHAPTER I
PRELIMINARY
2. Persons subject to the
Ordinance.--Every person enrolled or deemed to be enrolled shall be subject
to this Ordinance wherever he may be and shall remain so subject until his
discharge in accordance with this Ordinance.

Definitions

THE PAKISTAN MUJAHID FORCE ORDINANCE, 1965
THE PAKISTAN
MUJAHID FORCE ORDINANCE, 1965
ORDINANCE No. XXII
of 1965
[Approved by the National Assembly on 21st July, 1965, see
Gaz. of P. 1965. Ext. on. 588-592.]
[8th June, 1965]
An Ordinance to provide for the constitution and
discipline of the Pakistan Mujahid Force
CHAPTER I
PRELIMINARY
3. Definitions.--In this
Ordinance, unless there is anything repugnant in the subject or context,-
(1)
"Commander-in-Chief" means the Commander-in -Chief of the Pakistan
Army;
(2) "
commanding officer " means,-
(a) when used in
relation to a person subject to this Ordinance, the officer for the time being
in command-of the portion of the Force to which such person belongs or is
attached ; and
(b) when used
with reference to any separate portion of the Force, the officer whose duty it
is under the regulations of the Force, or in the absence of such regulations,
by its custom, to discharge with respect to that portion the functions of the
commanding officer
(3) "
district " means a revenue district of a Province ;
(4) "
enrolled " means enrolled or re-enrolled in the Force under this Ordinance
;
(5) " Force
" means the Pakistan Mujahid Force constituted under this Ordinance ;
(6) "
Junior commissioned officer " means a person commissioned, gazetted or in
pay as a junior com missioned officer in the Force ;
(7) "
non-commissioned officer " means a person enrolled under this Ordinance
and holding non commissioned rank in the Force ;
(8) "
officer " means a person commissioned, gazetted or in pay as an officer of
the Force, but does not include a junior commissioned officer ;
(9) "
prescribed " means prescribed by rules made under this Ordinance ; and
(10) " unit
" means a unit of the Force.

Constitution of Pakistan Mujahid Force

THE PAKISTAN MUJAHID FORCE ORDINANCE, 1965
THE PAKISTAN
MUJAHID FORCE ORDINANCE, 1965
ORDINANCE No. XXII
of 1965
[Approved by the National Assembly on 21st July, 1965, see
Gaz. of P. 1965. Ext. on. 588-592.]
[8th June, 1965]
An Ordinance to provide for the constitution and
discipline of the Pakistan Mujahid Force
CHAPTER II
CONSTITUTION AND CONTROL OF PAKISTAN MUJAHID FORCE
4. Constitution of Pakistan
Mujahid Force.--There shall be raised and maintained in accordance with the
provisions of this Ordinance a force to be designated the Pakistan Mujahid
Force.

Constitution and disbandment of units

THE PAKISTAN MUJAHID FORCE ORDINANCE, 1965
THE PAKISTAN
MUJAHID FORCE ORDINANCE, 1965
ORDINANCE No. XXII
of 1965
[Approved by the National Assembly on 21st July, 1965, see
Gaz. of P. 1965. Ext. on. 588-592.]
[8th June, 1965]
An Ordinance to provide for the constitution and
discipline of the Pakistan Mujahid Force
CHAPTER II
CONSTITUTION AND CONTROL OF PAKISTAN MUJAHID FORCE
5. Constitution and
disbandment of units.--The Commander-in-Chief may constitute for any
district one or more units to be recruited from persons residing a in such
district and may disband or reconstitute any unit so constituted:
Provided that where the
Commander-in-Chief is of the opinion that it is not practicable to recruit a
unit from the district for which it has been constituted, he may, by order in
writing, au thorise its recruitment from persons residing in any other
district.

Personnel of the Pakistan Mujahid Force

THE PAKISTAN MUJAHID FORCE ORDINANCE, 1965
THE PAKISTAN
MUJAHID FORCE ORDINANCE, 1965
ORDINANCE No. XXII
of 1965
[Approved by the National Assembly on 21st July, 1965, see
Gaz. of P. 1965. Ext. on. 588-592.]
[8th June, 1965]
An Ordinance to provide for the constitution and
discipline of the Pakistan Mujahid Force
CHAPTER II
CONSTITUTION AND CONTROL OF PAKISTAN MUJAHID FORCE
6. Personnel of the Pakistan
Mujahid Force.--[ Subs. by the Pakistan Mujahid
Force (Amdt.) Ordinance, 1965 (36 of 1965), s. 2, for the original section 6.](1)
There shall be the following classes of personnel in the Force, namely :-
(a) officers
holding commissions in the Force granted by the President;
(b) junior
commissioned officers holding commissions in the Force granted by the President
;
(c)
non-commissioned officers ;
(d) mujahids;
and
(e) recruits.
(2) An officer or a junior
commissioned officer shall be deemed to be enrolled in the Force for so long as
he holds commission therein.]

Enrolment

THE PAKISTAN MUJAHID FORCE ORDINANCE, 1965
THE PAKISTAN
MUJAHID FORCE ORDINANCE, 1965
ORDINANCE No. XXII
of 1965
[Approved by the National Assembly on 21st July, 1965, see
Gaz. of P. 1965. Ext. on. 588-592.]
[8th June, 1965]
An Ordinance to provide for the constitution and
discipline of the Pakistan Mujahid Force
CHAPTER III
ENROLMENT,
TRANSFER, DISCHARGE, ETC.
7. Enrolment.---(1) Any
person being a citizen of Pakistan may offer himself for enrolment in the Force
for service in the unit constituted for the district in which he resides and
any such person who satisfies the conditions laid down in the regulations may
be enrolled for the prescribed period and in the prescribed manner
Provided that where the
Commander-in-Chief authorizes under the proviso to section 5 the recruitment of
a unit from persons belonging to a district-other than that for which that unit
was constituted, an applicant may apply to be enrolled in the Force for service
in any unit so recruited.
(2) Every person enrolled shall,
without unnecessary delay, be appointed to a unit in which he has applied for
service.
[(3) Any person who, immediately
before the commence ment of this Ordinance, was enrolled in, or was a member
of, a mujahid force shall, upon such commencement, be deemed to be enrolled in
the Force under this Ordinance.][ Sub-section (3) added
and shall be deemed always to have been so added by the Pakistan Mujahid Force
(Second Amdt.) Ordinance, 1965 (38 of 1965), s. 2.]

Transfer and attachment

THE PAKISTAN MUJAHID FORCE ORDINANCE, 1965
THE PAKISTAN
MUJAHID FORCE ORDINANCE, 1965
ORDINANCE No. XXII
of 1965
[Approved by the National Assembly on 21st July, 1965, see
Gaz. of P. 1965. Ext. on. 588-592.]
[8th June, 1965]
An Ordinance to provide for the constitution and
discipline of the Pakistan Mujahid Force
CHAPTER III
ENROLMENT,
TRANSFER, DISCHARGE, ETC.
8. Transfer and attachment.--Notwithstanding
anything contained in section 7, any person appointed to a unit may,
(a) with his
consent, be transferred, whether on disbandment of the unit or otherwise, to
another unit in such manner as may be prescribed ; and
(b) at his
request, be attached to another unit.

Liability for military training

THE PAKISTAN MUJAHID FORCE ORDINANCE, 1965
THE PAKISTAN
MUJAHID FORCE ORDINANCE, 1965
ORDINANCE No. XXII
of 1965
[Approved by the National Assembly on 21st July, 1965, see
Gaz. of P. 1965. Ext. on. 588-592.]
[8th June, 1965]
An Ordinance to provide for the constitution and
discipline of the Pakistan Mujahid Force
CHAPTER III
ENROLMENT,
TRANSFER, DISCHARGE, ETC.
9. Liability for military
training.--Persons subject to this Ordinance and the units shall liable to be called up for military training
and for the purpose of such training their command and control shall be
regulated according to the orders of the Commander-in-Chief or an authority
empowered by him in this behalf.

Liability to serve and perform military service

THE PAKISTAN MUJAHID FORCE ORDINANCE, 1965
THE PAKISTAN
MUJAHID FORCE ORDINANCE, 1965
ORDINANCE No. XXII
of 1965
[Approved by the National Assembly on 21st July, 1965, see
Gaz. of P. 1965. Ext. on. 588-592.]
[8th June, 1965]
An Ordinance to provide for the constitution and
discipline of the Pakistan Mujahid Force
CHAPTER III
ENROLMENT,
TRANSFER, DISCHARGE, ETC.
10. Liability to serve and
perform military service.---(1) Every person subject to this Ordinance
shall be liable to serve in any unit of the Force to which he has been
appointed or transferred or is for the time being attached and shall be subject
to all rules and regulations made under this Ordinance.
(2) Every such person shall be
liable to perform military service-
(a) when called
out with any portion of the Force by an order of the senior officer of the
Pakistan Army present, either to act in support of the civil power or to
provide guards which, in the opinion of such officer, are essential, or
(b) when the
unit to which he belongs has been embodied to support or supplement the Pakistan
Army by an order directing such embodiment of the Commander -in-Chief or an
authority empowered by him in this behalf.

sections.description:
Discharge

THE PAKISTAN MUJAHID FORCE ORDINANCE, 1965
THE PAKISTAN
MUJAHID FORCE ORDINANCE, 1965
ORDINANCE No. XXII
of 1965
[Approved by the National Assembly on 21st July, 1965, see
Gaz. of P. 1965. Ext. on. 588-592.]
[8th June, 1965]
An Ordinance to provide for the constitution and
discipline of the Pakistan Mujahid Force
CHAPTER III
ENROLMENT,
TRANSFER, DISCHARGE, ETC.
11. Discharge.---(1) Every
person enrolled shall be entitled to receive his discharge from the Force on
the expiration of the period for which he was enrolled and may, before the
expiration of that period, be discharged from the Force by such authority and
subject to such conditions as may be prescribed:
Provided that a person enrolled
who is for the time being engaged in military service shall not be entitled to
receive his discharge before the termination of such service.
(2) Every person enrolled who
becomes entitled to discharge under sub-section (1) shall be discharged with
all convenient speed.

Application of the Pakistan Army Act 1952

THE PAKISTAN MUJAHID FORCE ORDINANCE, 1965
THE PAKISTAN
MUJAHID FORCE ORDINANCE, 1965
ORDINANCE No. XXII
of 1965
[Approved by the National Assembly on 21st July, 1965, see
Gaz. of P. 1965. Ext. on. 588-592.]
[8th June, 1965]
An Ordinance to provide for the constitution and
discipline of the Pakistan Mujahid Force
CHAPTER IV
MISCELLANEOUS
12. Application of the
Pakistan Army Act 1952.---(1) Subject to the terms and conditions of his
commission and any order of the President made in this behalf, every officer or
junior commissioned officer, when doing duty as such officer or junior
commissioned officer shall be subject x to the provisions of the Pakistan Army
Act, 1952, and the rules and regulations made thereunder as if such officer
held the same rank in the Pakistan Army as he, for the time being, holds in the
Force.
(2) Subject to any order of the
Commander-in-Chief made in this behalf, every non-commissioned officer and man
of the Force,
(a) when
embodied for, or otherwise undergoing, military training, or
(b) when called
out or embodied for military service under Section 10, shall be subject to the
Pakistan Army Act, 1952, and rules and regulations made there under as if he
held the same rank in the Pakistan Army as he, for the time being, holds in the
Force XXXIX of 1952:
Provided that the said Act, rules
and regulations shall, in their application to such non-commissioned officers
and men when embodied for or otherwise undergoing military training, be
modified to such extent and in such manner as may be prescribed.
(3) Where any person while he is
subject to the provisions of the Pakistan Army Act, 1952, commits any offence
punishable thereunder, he may, notwithstanding that he may have ceased to be so
subject, be taken into and kept in military custody and tried and punished for
such offence in the same manner as he would have been liable to be tried and
punished had he not ceased to be so subject.

Presumption as to certain documents

THE PAKISTAN MUJAHID FORCE ORDINANCE, 1965
THE PAKISTAN
MUJAHID FORCE ORDINANCE, 1965
ORDINANCE No. XXII
of 1965
[Approved by the National Assembly on 21st July, 1965, see
Gaz. of P. 1965. Ext. on. 588-592.]
[8th June, 1965]
An Ordinance to provide for the constitution and
discipline of the Pakistan Mujahid Force
CHAPTER IV
MISCELLANEOUS
13. Presumption as to certain
documents.--When any person enrolled, other than an officer, is pursuance
of any rule or order made under a certificate purporting to be signed by the
prescribed officer stating that the person so required to attend has failed to
attend in accordance with such requirement shall, without proof of the
signature or appointment of such officer, be evidence of the matter stated
therein.

Persons subject to the Ordinance to be deemed part of the Pakistan Army

THE PAKISTAN MUJAHID FORCE ORDINANCE, 1965
THE PAKISTAN
MUJAHID FORCE ORDINANCE, 1965
ORDINANCE No. XXII
of 1965
[Approved by the National Assembly on 21st July, 1965, see
Gaz. of P. 1965. Ext. on. 588-592.]
[8th June, 1965]
An Ordinance to provide for the constitution and
discipline of the Pakistan Mujahid Force
CHAPTER IV
MISCELLANEOUS
14. Persons subject to the
Ordinance to be deemed part of the Pakistan Army.--For the purposes of
sections 128, 130 and 131 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898, all
officers, junior commis sioned officers, non-commissioned officers and men of
the Force who have been appointed to a unit shall be deemed to be officers,
junior commissioned officers, non-commissioned officers and soldiers
respectively of the Pakistan Army, Act V of 1898.

Exemption from local taxation

THE PAKISTAN MUJAHID FORCE ORDINANCE, 1965
THE PAKISTAN
MUJAHID FORCE ORDINANCE, 1965
ORDINANCE No. XXII
of 1965
[Approved by the National Assembly on 21st July, 1965, see
Gaz. of P. 1965. Ext. on. 588-592.]
[8th June, 1965]
An Ordinance to provide for the constitution and
discipline of the Pakistan Mujahid Force
CHAPTER IV
MISCELLANEOUS
15. Exemption from local
taxation.---Notwithstanding anything contained in any other law for the
time being in force, no person shall be liable to pay any municipal or other
tax in respect of any horse, bicycle, motor cycle, scooter, motorcar or other
conveyance which he is required or authorised by a general or special order of
the Commander -in-Chief to maintain in his capacity as a person enrolled in; or
as a person otherwise connected with, the Force.

sections.description:
Power to make rules

THE PAKISTAN MUJAHID FORCE ORDINANCE, 1965
THE PAKISTAN
MUJAHID FORCE ORDINANCE, 1965
ORDINANCE No. XXII
of 1965
[Approved by the National Assembly on 21st July, 1965, see
Gaz. of P. 1965. Ext. on. 588-592.]
[8th June, 1965]
An Ordinance to provide for the constitution and
discipline of the Pakistan Mujahid Force
CHAPTER IV
MISCELLANEOUS
16. Power to make rules.---(1)
The Central Government may, by notification in the official Gazette, make
rules[For Such rules, see Gaz. of P., 1965, Ext., pp.
1105--1108:] for carrying out the purposes of this Ordinance.
(2) In particular, and without
prejudice to the generality of the foregoing power, such rules may-
(a) prescribe
the period for which and the manner in which persons may be enrolled;
(b) prescribe
the manner in which a person enrolled may be transferred ;
(c) provide for
and regulate the remuneration, allowan ces, gratuities or compensation to be
paid to the persons subject to this Ordinance or to their dependants ;
(d) prescribe
the extent to which and the manner in which the provisions of the Pakistan Army
Act, .1952, and the rules and regulations made thereunder shall be modified in
their application to the non-com missioned officers and men of the Force when
embodied for or otherwise undergoing military training ;
(e) prescribe
the officers by whom certificates may be signed under section 13 ;
(f) provide for
the medical examination of persons offering themselves for enrolment in the
Force ;
(g) prescribe
the authorities by whom and the conditions subject to which persons enrolled
may be discharged ;
(h) provide for
any other matter which may be necessary for carrying the provisions of this
Ordinance into effect.

Power to make regulations

THE PAKISTAN MUJAHID FORCE ORDINANCE, 1965
THE PAKISTAN
MUJAHID FORCE ORDINANCE, 1965
ORDINANCE No. XXII
of 1965
[Approved by the National Assembly on 21st July, 1965, see
Gaz. of P. 1965. Ext. on. 588-592.]
[8th June, 1965]
An Ordinance to provide for the constitution and
discipline of the Pakistan Mujahid Force
CHAPTER IV
MISCELLANEOUS
17. Power to make
regulations.--The Commander-in-Chief may make regulations, not inconsistent
with this Ordinance and the rules made thereunder, to provide generally for all
details connected with the constitution, raising, organization, administration,
embodiment and dis bandment of the Force of any of its units, including
provisions governing duties, military training, courses of training or
instruction, clothing, equipment, pay and allowances, bonus and awards, leave,
conveyance and medical treatment of the persons enrolled.
